findings: The captured log predates the Subject scalar fix; the later nine-failure report is not a captured log here. Reproduced the lookup failure against the current shared fixture.
Without current_scope_unit, implicit legacy, explicit legacy and explicit approved each returned zero occurrences, limited coverage, and source-invalid: Atom metadata is incomplete or invalid.

In a fresh disposable fixture only, injecting a matching current_scope_unit made implicit legacy and explicit approved both return one match, full coverage and no diagnostics. This was a diagnostic, not a proposed carrier migration.

atom_subject_lookup._request explicitly defaults to legacy. The test fixture get_profile patch preserves the requested name; it supplies fixture grammar pins and does not force an explicitly approved request to legacy. The profiles describe Subject expression grammar, not carrier-key schema.

carrier_read_view supplies read-only legacy aliases from active/passive; _structured_subjects uses them. The failing lookup rejects the source earlier because it requires metadata current_scope_unit in owners; the Current Plan fixture intentionally omits the legacy field. Approved profile alone does not resolve it.
